description: Points a merchant's subdomain (for example shop.example.com) at their Flowhub online store with one CNAME. Apply it with the host parameter; a CNAME can't sit at a zone apex.
variableDescription: %target%: the Flowhub storefront routing endpoint the subdomain points to, a hostname such as d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net. It differs between Flowhub's environments.
